Android emulator FPS and traffic do not establish physical-device power, thermal, audio or cellular behavior.
Warm packet counts cover the media-session proxy only; discovery and public relay background traffic are outside this counter.
Initial emulator trials saw heartbeat timeouts; later fresh sessions passed. The early cause is unresolved.
Desktop custom FPS is integer-only; requested rates are bounded by source/display/encoder/network. Bitrate is a target, not fixed wire traffic.
FCM and OEM push are documented architecture, not implemented.
